items.summary: Recommendation: retain the financial-claim and implementation gates. Reject revenue, contribution-margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, causal-lift, forecast, and budget-exposure claims this cycle. Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but the full commission is on aggregate tracking_id other and cannot be assigned to a site. AI spend is $34.69846565 across 223 calls on 2026-10-01, with only 20 observed sites versus 38 expected. Contribution margin and cost-to-learn are not calculable because revenue and AI spend are not period-aligned, infrastructure/domain costs and budgets are absent, AI attribution is incomplete, and the 30-day outcome set cannot be causally matched to one-day spend. Minimum measurement: period-aligned site/content revenue by registered tracking ID, AI cost allocation by site/work item, infrastructure and domain costs, dated exposures and control/treatment outcomes, and explicit monthly budget limits. Retain only the existing capacity reconciliation and bounded read-only research; release at most one candidate only after all operational and measurement gates pass.
